description: Lazarski University, one of the first universities that come to mind when education is mentioned in Poland, was established in 1993. Lazarski University has approximately 5000 students. The university, which has more than 300 faculty members, accepts students from 29 different countries. Lazarski University has the law, economics, management, finance and accounting, international relations, and public administration.
